title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Chronicles chapter 6 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Chronicles Chapter 6.

questions.question: Who were the sons of Levi according to 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:1 states that the sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT a son of Kohath?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:2 lists the sons of Kohath as Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel; Phinehas is a descendant but not a son of Kohath.

questions.question: Who were the children of Amram?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:3 tells us that the children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.

questions.question: Who were the sons of Aaron as listed in 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:3 specifies that Aaron’s sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

questions.question: Who was the father of Phinehas?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:4 states that Eleazar begat Phinehas.

questions.question: Which of these men begat Bukki?
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 6:5, Abishua begat Bukki.

questions.question: Who was the son of Uzzi?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:6 states that Uzzi begat Zerahiah.

questions.question: True or False: Zadok was begotten by Ahitub.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:8 tells us Ahitub begat Zadok.

questions.question: Who executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:10 states Azariah, son of Johanan, executed the priest's office in Solomon's temple.

questions.question: True or False: Jehozadak was taken into captivity by Nebuchadnezzar.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:15 records that Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar.

questions.question: Which two were the sons of Gershom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:17 states that the sons of Gershom were Libni and Shimei.

questions.question: True or False: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:19 confirms that the sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi.

questions.question: Who was the father of Elkanah among the sons of Kohath?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:23 states that Elkanah was the son of Assir among the sons of Kohath.

questions.question: True or False: Jeroham was the son of Eliab.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:27 shows the genealogy including Jeroham as the son of Eliab.

questions.question: In 1 Chronicles 6, which name appears first in the genealogy of the sons of Gershom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:20 lists Libni as the first son of Gershom in the genealogy.

medium.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Who were the sons of Samuel mentioned in 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:28 states that the sons of Samuel were the firstborn Vashni and Abiah.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 6, which of the following was NOT a son of Merari?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:29 lists Mahli, Libni, Shimei, and others as sons of Merari, but Joel is not mentioned here and is instead found in the Kohathite lineage (1 Chronicles 6:33).

questions.question: What role did David assign to the Levites mentioned in 1 Chronicles 6:31?
options: Service of song in the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Service of song in the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:31 explains that David set these Levites over the service of song in the house of the LORD after the ark had rest.

questions.question: How long did the Levites minister with singing before Solomon built the house of the LORD?
options: Until Solomon built the house of the LORD
Only during the time of David
questions.correctAnswer: Until Solomon built the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:32 states they ministered before the tabernacle with singing until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.

questions.question: Heman, who waited with his children, was a descendant of which tribe according to 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:33 shows Heman, a singer, was among the sons of the Kohathites who waited with their children.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 6, who stood on Heman’s right hand?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:39 states that Asaph, the son of Berachiah, stood on Heman’s right hand.

questions.question: True or False: The sons of Merari stood on the right hand during the service in the house of the LORD.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:44 explains that the sons of Merari stood on the left hand, not the right.

questions.question: What service were the Levites appointed to according to 1 Chronicles 6:48?
options: All manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God
questions.correctAnswer: All manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:48 states that the Levites were appointed to all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 6:49, what special role did Aaron and his sons have?
options: Offering on the altar of burnt offering and incense
Teaching the law to the people
questions.correctAnswer: Offering on the altar of burnt offering and incense
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:49 explains that Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of burnt offering and incense and were appointed for the most holy work.

questions.question: Who among the sons of Aaron was the father of Phinehas as recorded in 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:50-51 shows Eleazar was the father of Phinehas.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 6:54 say about the dwelling places of the sons of Aaron?
options: They were given castles and coasts by lot
They lived scattered among all tribes
They had no specific dwelling places
questions.correctAnswer: They were given castles and coasts by lot
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:54 states the sons of Aaron had dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts by lot.

questions.question: How does the passage in 1 Chronicles 6:31-32 teach about faith and trust in God?
options: By showing the Levites faithfully served through song until the temple was built
By encouraging immediate construction of a temple without waiting
By emphasizing military service over worship
By requiring the Levites to leave service after the ark rested
questions.correctAnswer: By showing the Levites faithfully served through song until the temple was built
questions.explanation: Verses 31 and 32 show the Levites ministered with singing faithfully before the tabernacle until Solomon built the temple, teaching us perseverance in worship and trusting God's timing.

questions.question: What biblical truth from 1 Chronicles 6:49-50 helps a believer struggling with obedience to God’s commands?
options: Obedience involves dedicated service like Aaron and his sons offering sacrifices
Obedience requires leaving family to serve alone
Obedience is only about personal prayer
Obedience means leading public worship only
questions.correctAnswer: Obedience involves dedicated service like Aaron and his sons offering sacrifices
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:49-50 shows Aaron and his sons were appointed to offer sacrifices as commanded by Moses, modeling faithful obedience to God’s instructions.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 6:33-38, Heman was a son of Gershom.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:33-38 shows Heman was a son of Kohath, not Gershom, clarifying genealogical distinctions in Levitical families.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 6:54, the families of the Kohathites received their dwelling places by lot.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:54 explicitly states the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, received their dwelling places throughout their castles by lot.

hard.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Chronicles Chapter 6.

questions.question: Which city was given to the sons of Aaron in the land of Judah as a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 6:57 states that the sons of Aaron were given Hebron, the city of refuge, along with other cities in Judah.

questions.question: To whom were the fields and villages of Hebron given, according to 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:56 clearly states that the fields of the city and villages thereof were given to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

questions.question: How many cities were given to the sons of Gershom from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 6:62 specifies that thirteen cities were given to the sons of Gershom from those tribes.

questions.question: Which tribe provided cities by lot to the sons of Merari?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:63 says that the sons of Merari were given cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

questions.question: Which city of refuge was given to the sons of Kohath in the tribe of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 6:67, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs was a city of refuge given to the sons of Kohath.

questions.question: Which city given to the sons of Gershom was located in Bashan?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 6:71 states that Golan in Bashan with its suburbs was given to the sons of Gershom.

questions.question: What was the role of Aaron and his sons according to 1 Chronicles 6:49?
options: Offering on the altar of burnt offering and incense
questions.correctAnswer: Offering on the altar of burnt offering and incense
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:49 states that Aaron and his sons were appointed for the work of offering upon the altar of burnt offering and incense, making atonement for Israel.

questions.question: How many cities with their suburbs were given to the sons of Aaron throughout their families?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:60 states that all their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

questions.question: Which tribe's cities were given to the sons of Kohath from the half tribe of Manasseh?
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 6:61, the sons of Kohath were given cities by lot from the half tribe of Manasseh.

questions.question: Which Levite is identified as a singer and descendant of Kohath in 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: Verses 1 Chronicles 6:33-38 identify Heman, a son of Joel, as a singer and descendant of Kohath.

questions.question: True or False: The Levites were only appointed to serve in musical worship and did not have any other duties in the tabernacle or temple.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:48 explains that the Levites were appointed to all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God, not limited to musical worship.

questions.question: True or False: Jehozadak was taken into captivity when Nebuchadnezzar carried away Judah and Jerusalem.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:15 states that Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

questions.question: Which Hebrew word meaning 'city of refuge' is illustrated in 1 Chronicles 6 through the cities given to the Levites?
questions.explanation: The term ‘Ir Miphqad (city of refuge) is used in the Hebrew Bible to describe cities like Hebron and Shechem given to the Levites as places of refuge, as seen in 1 Chronicles 6:57 and 6:67.

questions.question: What literary device is used in 1 Chronicles 6 in the listing of genealogies and cities, reflecting a structured and ordered presentation of the Levites' inheritance?
questions.explanation: The chapter uses inclusion by starting and ending with genealogies and city assignments, framing the Levites' role and inheritance in an ordered manner (e.g., 1 Chronicles 6:1 and 6:81).

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of priestly service and lineage as detailed in 1 Chronicles 6?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7 discusses the priesthood of Melchizedek and connects to the Levitical priesthood genealogies found in 1 Chronicles 6, emphasizing priestly lineage and service.

theological.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Chronicles Chapter 6 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: Which sons of Levi are named as the primary ancestors of the Levitical families?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:1 establishes Gershon, Kohath, and Merari as the sons of Levi, the patriarchs from whom the Levitical families descend, indicating the foundational tribal divisions within the priestly class.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is illustrated by the priestly genealogy from Aaron to Ahimaaz in verses 3-10?
questions.explanation: Verses 3-10 trace the unbroken priestly lineage from Aaron to Ahimaaz, showing the continuity and perpetuity of the priesthood established by God, which foreshadows Christ's eternal priesthood (Hebrews 7:23-24).

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 6:15, what event led to Jehozadak going into captivity?
options: The LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar
The Israelites were scattered by the Assyrians
The destruction of the temple by the Babylonians
The exile to Egypt during famine
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:15 explicitly states that Jehozadak went into captivity because the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, demonstrating God's sovereign judgment over Israel.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is revealed by the detailed genealogies and appointments of Levites in 1 Chronicles 6:16-19?
options: God’s faithfulness in preserving His covenant people
questions.correctAnswer: God’s faithfulness in preserving His covenant people
questions.explanation: The precise genealogies and divisions of the Levites in verses 16-19 show God's faithfulness in maintaining the covenant lineage and priestly order through generations, preserving His people for His redemptive purposes.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 6:31-32 illustrate the role of music and worship in the redemptive narrative of Israel?
options: Music and worship were integral to the tabernacle and temple service, reflecting God's desire for praise
Music was forbidden in the temple until Solomon's reign
Only Levites could sing, but it was unrelated to worship
Music was a form of secular entertainment in Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Music and worship were integral to the tabernacle and temple service, reflecting God's desire for praise
questions.explanation: Verses 31-32 describe how David appointed Levites to serve with music before the tabernacle and later the temple, demonstrating that worship through song was a divinely instituted element in Israel's covenant relationship with God, pointing toward the ultimate worship in heaven.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal insight emerges from 1 Chronicles 6:49 and 6:50-53 regarding the priesthood and atonement?
options: Aaron and his sons alone were appointed for the holy work of atonement, highlighting the sanctity and mediation role of the priesthood
All Levites equally shared the work of atonement
The priesthood was an optional role in Israel
Atonement was performed by the elders, not priests
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron and his sons alone were appointed for the holy work of atonement, highlighting the sanctity and mediation role of the priesthood
questions.explanation: Verse 49 teaches that Aaron and his sons were specifically appointed for the most holy work of offering sacrifices and making atonement, and verses 50-53 list this priestly lineage, underscoring the exclusive mediatorial function of the Aaronic priesthood as foreshadowing Christ’s perfect mediation (Hebrews 9:11-12).

questions.question: Which doctrinal truth about God’s justice is demonstrated in 1 Chronicles 6:15 regarding the captivity under Nebuchadnezzar?
options: God executes just judgment on unfaithfulness
God is indifferent to Israel’s sins
God’s justice is limited to individuals only
questions.correctAnswer: God executes just judgment on unfaithfulness
questions.explanation: Verse 15 shows that the captivity was a direct consequence of God's sovereign judgment, illustrating that God’s justice entails punishing corporate unfaithfulness and rebellion, consistent with His righteous governance (Deuteronomy 28:64).

questions.question: How do the cities given to the Levites in 1 Chronicles 6:54-81 reflect God's provision and sanctification for His people?
options: God provided distinct cities with suburbs to the Levites, facilitating their consecrated service among the tribes
Levites were left without land inheritance
The Levites received only one city without suburbs
The cities were given to Levites to establish political power
questions.correctAnswer: God provided distinct cities with suburbs to the Levites, facilitating their consecrated service among the tribes
questions.explanation: The extensive list of cities and suburbs in verses 54-81 shows God’s provision for the Levites to dwell among Israel, enabling their sanctified ministry and teaching role, illustrating God’s care for the spiritual welfare of the nation.

questions.question: What synthesis of doctrine about priestly succession and worship is taught by combining 1 Chronicles 6:33-38 and 6:39-43?
options: God ordains specific families and individuals for worship roles, ensuring orderly and continual service before Him
Worship roles were assigned randomly among the tribes
Only one family was responsible for all temple functions
Worship was a spontaneous act without appointed ministers
questions.correctAnswer: God ordains specific families and individuals for worship roles, ensuring orderly and continual service before Him
questions.explanation: Verses 33-38 and 39-43 detail genealogies of worship leaders from Kohath and Gershom families, showing God’s sovereign appointment of worship ministers to maintain reverent and continual service, reflecting divine order in worship (Exodus 28).

questions.question: Sceptics claim the detailed genealogies in 1 Chronicles 6 serve no theological purpose and are merely historical filler. What does 1 Chronicles 6:1-15 actually teach about God’s covenant faithfulness and priestly mediation?
options: The genealogies demonstrate God's ongoing covenant faithfulness by preserving the priestly line, vital for Israel's atonement and worship
The genealogies are irrelevant to theology and only serve historical record-keeping
The genealogies show human pride rather than divine purpose
They prove the priesthood was a later human invention
questions.correctAnswer: The genealogies demonstrate God's ongoing covenant faithfulness by preserving the priestly line, vital for Israel's atonement and worship
questions.explanation: Verses 1-15 trace the priestly lineage from Levi through Aaron to Jehozadak, underscoring God's faithfulness in maintaining the priestly covenant for mediation and atonement, a foundation for understanding Christ as the ultimate High Priest (Hebrews 7:24-25).

questions.question: What attribute of God is emphasized by the specific cities assigned to the Levites in 1 Chronicles 6:57-60?
options: God’s providence in ensuring the Levites had places to minister among the tribes
questions.correctAnswer: God’s providence in ensuring the Levites had places to minister among the tribes
questions.explanation: The allocation of specific cities and suburbs to the Levites (verses 57-60) shows God's providential care in providing dwelling places for His servants to perform their sacred duties throughout Israel, demonstrating His sustaining governance.

questions.question: What narrative arc in redemptive history is highlighted by 1 Chronicles 6:15 and 6:49-50 regarding the exile and priesthood?
options: The exile interrupts the priestly line, but God's covenant promises sustain the priesthood's future restoration
The exile permanently ends the priesthood
The priesthood is unrelated to Israel's exile
The exile was a result of unfaithful priests only
questions.correctAnswer: The exile interrupts the priestly line, but God's covenant promises sustain the priesthood's future restoration
questions.explanation: Verse 15 mentions Jehozadak's captivity, signaling exile, while verses 49-50 affirm the ongoing priestly lineage and duties, indicating that despite exile, God's covenant faithfulness ensures priestly restoration, foreshadowing restoration in Christ (Ezra 3:10-13).

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 6:22-27 contribute to the doctrine of God's sovereign election and human responsibility within the Levitical families?
options: The detailed genealogies show God’s sovereign election of specific families and the human responsibility to maintain their covenant roles
The genealogies disprove any divine election
Levitical roles were assigned randomly without divine purpose
Human responsibility is negated by divine election here
questions.correctAnswer: The detailed genealogies show God’s sovereign election of specific families and the human responsibility to maintain their covenant roles
questions.explanation: Verses 22-27 list successive generations within Kohath and Elkanah’s line, illustrating God’s sovereign choice of families for priestly service, while implying the human duty to faithfully uphold their sacred offices (Romans 8:28-30).

questions.question: What synthesis about God's holiness and mediation is revealed by combining 1 Chronicles 6:49 and 6:3-4 regarding Aaron and his sons' roles?
options: Aaron and his sons alone were appointed for the holy work of mediation and atonement, reflecting God's requirement for holiness in approaching Him
All Levites shared equally in mediation
Mediation was unnecessary in Israel’s worship
God accepted sacrifices from any tribe without restriction
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron and his sons alone were appointed for the holy work of mediation and atonement, reflecting God's requirement for holiness in approaching Him
questions.explanation: Verse 49 states that Aaron and his sons offered sacrifices and made atonement, while verses 3-4 list Aaron's sons, establishing the exclusive priestly line. This shows God’s holiness demands a sanctified mediator, prefiguring Christ’s unique priesthood (Hebrews 5:1-6).

questions.question: What combined theological insight do 1 Chronicles 6:31 and 6:39-43 provide about corporate worship and the role of Levites?
options: Levites were divinely appointed to lead congregational worship through music, emphasizing God’s desire for ordered praise
Only priests sang in the temple
Music was a secular activity with no religious significance
questions.correctAnswer: Levites were divinely appointed to lead congregational worship through music, emphasizing God’s desire for ordered praise
questions.explanation: Verse 31 records David setting Levites over singing in the house of the Lord, and verses 39-43 detail genealogies of these singers, showing divine institution of worship leadership, reflecting God's attribute of order and desire for reverent praise (Psalm 150).
